授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will build English language competence by engaging with topics related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Students will learn to explain issues, compare perspectives, and generate solutions using appropriate vocabulary and expressions. Through Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL), group discussions, and problem-solving tasks, students will develop the skills needed to research issues, communicate ideas clearly, and collaborate in English.
advice:
This seminar provides opportunities for students to explore global themes and social issues connected to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through English. Students will engage in various content-based activities that promote both language development and critical thinking.

Throughout the course, students will discuss ideas, analyze information, and express their thoughts in English through pair work, group discussions, and short presentations.

Before each class, students must check Moodle and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class.
books: CLIL 英語で学ぶSDGsの基礎 CLIL Primary SDGs
requiredKnowledge: Students started English studies at KIT from Topics 5 or passed an intermediate-level course with a grade of A or higher.

activityGoals.body: Students will engage with global and social issues.
Students will be able to interpret and present information effectively.
Students will employ appropriate presentation language and expressions.
Students will demonstrate their understanding of target vocabulary by using it appropriately in sentences.
Students will synthesize information and express viewpoints logically and coherently.

achievementLevels.ideal:
- Students can lead group activities and work collaboratively with group members.
- Students develop a strong awareness of different viewpoints through reading.
- Students demonstrate the ability to form developed opinions and express them clearly in writing and speaking.
- Students can comprehend information from the textbook and effectively present it with clear visual aids.
achievementLevels.standard:
- Students can understand their role in group activities and work collaboratively with group members.
- Students develop a basic understanding of different viewpoints through reading.
- Students demonstrate the ability to form somewhat developed opinions and express them adequately in writing and speaking.
- Students can comprehend information from the textbook and present it on a poster with basic visual aids.

              In this course, students will build English language competence by engaging with topics related to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Students will learn to explain issues, compare perspectives, and generate solutions using appropriate vocabulary and expressions. Through Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL), group discussions, and problem-solving tasks, students will develop the skills needed to research issues, communicate ideas clearly, and collaborate in English.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This seminar provides opportunities for students to explore global themes and social issues connected to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) through English. Students will engage in various content-based activities that promote both language development and critical thinking.

Throughout the course, students will discuss ideas, analyze information, and express their thoughts in English through pair work, group discussions, and short presentations.

Before each class, students must check Moodle and the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class.
